start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:make-a-cover-from-outside-inspiration for my video record:content-pieces:example-ai-study as a YouTube thumbnail."

lists.label: Image inspiration sources
lists.holds: One place outside a platform to take visual ideas from (a curated thumbnail gallery, a Pinterest board, a poster archive), with what it is good for and how often its ideas won.

instructions: 1. Pour the example rows of list:image-inspiration-sources into the list you already keep for the same job (see pour), or make list:image-inspiration-sources from them.

2. Say to your AI: "Run workflow:make-a-cover-from-outside-inspiration", with piece (The piece the cover is for: a row id of the person's content, or its words.); surface (Where the cover appears, for example a YouTube thumbnail, an Instagram reel cover, the first slide of a carousel, a TikTok cover, a newsletter header, an article hero image or a printed postcard.); it starts it with tool:run-workflow-definition (row workflow:make-a-cover-from-outside-inspiration).
3. Study what outperformed on this surface: done when At least five outliers, each with a link or row id and the move named.
4. Pair a credible source with what culture is talking about: done when Every pair names where in the piece it is backed, and five or more headlines are drafted from the pairs.
5. Find the visual idea outside the platform: done when Three or more cited references, each with what is taken and how it is recreated.
6. Mock it up several ways: done when Four or more mockup files exist at the surface size, and two are kept with reasons.
7. Pick one and record how it did: done when The chosen cover is named; after publishing, its result and inspiration source are recorded on the piece.

8. Read what it gives back: A chosen cover and headline for the piece, the mockups it was chosen from, the cited references, and after publishing its click and outlier result tallied by inspiration source.

worked_examples.title: A credible source is paired with what people are talking about
worked_examples.ask: Make the thumbnail for my video about the new study on AI at work.
worked_examples.given: The piece cites a university study on AI and workplace productivity; the watched sources this week are full of a well-known chip maker's CEO talking about AI jobs.
worked_examples.hands_back: pairs [{credible: "the university study", attention: "the CEO's AI jobs remarks", backed_by: "minute 3:10 quotes the study's finding"}]; headlines ["The study says AI isn't working yet", "What the AI study found that CEOs won't say"]; rejected [].

pour.how: Name the list you already keep for the same job and read its fields and row type from your own store. Run tool:pour-example-rows-into-my-list with that list as into and this kit list as kit_list: it matches each kit field to one of yours (your map, the same id, the same label, or a name in alike), pours nothing under 80% and names the fields with no home, and otherwise answers the example rows to keep beside your own.
